messages.subject: knitr v1.3 (beta)
parts:
Hi,

It has been three months since knitr 1.2, and now I'm in preparation
for releasing knitr 1.3, which is available on Github:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr All changes and new features are
described in NEWS: https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/NEWS.md

I think the only thing that might affect you is the syntax
highlighting for LaTeX and HTML users (the LaTeX commands and HTML/CSS
classes have been renamed), especially if you have used cache. I have
tried my best to minimize the "surprise". Anyway, please test the
development version if you can, and let me know if there is anything
problematic. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: knitr v1.3 (beta)
parts:
You need update.packages(): https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues/400

You might want to report to Hadley or Winston that
devtools::install_github() does not respect the version requirements
in DESCRIPTION. In this case, I have specified evaluate >= 0.4.4, and
I think install_github() should check this before installing the
package. This problem has occurred several times, and that is the
reason I no longer put install_github() in the Installation
instructions: https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme

Regards,
Yihui
--
